title: A tale of two Nvidias
summary: We got two very different pictures of Nvidia —  the company’s latest earnings report vs. the tech executives loudly calling for Jensen Huang’s return.
llm_summary: Nvidia’s latest earnings report paints a picture of soaring revenue, record‑high AI chip demand and a stock that’s surged dramatically, suggesting the company is thriving under its current strategy.
